_comment: Retirement Fallen Phrase (quotefall) saying generation. A fallen phrase is set into a fixed grid of write-in boxes, so a saying is only usable if it wraps into that grid: `bands` mirrors BANDS in frontend/src/utils/studio/fallen-phrase/content.ts and must be edited in both places together. The word counts are the part that looks wrong and is not — a grid row is stretched at its word gaps, so a saying needs about three words per row before the wrap has enough joints to fill the width, which is why a short saying still asks for eight words. maxWordLetters is the narrowest grid any KDP trim prints, since a word is never broken across rows. candidateCounts: need 1 -> 10, so the page can discard the ones that will not grid. varietyAngles rotate by seed.
varietyAngles: friendship that lasted past the job
cooking for pleasure not the clock
creative time that is finally yours
rest that is earned and welcome
